newsitem.title: CANADA: St. Laurent Paperboard places note issue.
newsitem.headline: St. Laurent Paperboard places note issue.

text.p: St Laurent Paperboard Inc said on Wednesday that it placed privately with financial institutions in the United States US$125 million of senior unsecured notes.

They comprised US$30 million of 8.17 percent senior notes, due February 1, 2002, US$85 million of 8.41 percent senior notes series B, due November 1, 2006 and US$10 million 8.79 percent senior notes, series C, due November 1, 2008.

Proceeds from the sale of the notes will be used by the company to repay long-term and short-term debt incurred to finance recent investing activities, while the rest will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
